# /fix-defect — diagnose and fix a defect, governed and regression-tested

Turns `$ARGUMENTS` — an Azure DevOps PBI/bug id (e.g. `PBI 49120`, `Bug 49120`) or a pasted **stack trace** — into a diagnosed, surgically fixed, and regression-tested defect closure across the EQOne MFEs (`eq-nexus-ui` shell, `eq-one-saye-mfe` / `eq-one-sip-mfe` / `eq-one-shares-mfe`, `eq-one-shared`, `eq-one-design-system`) and the `ExperienceAPI` BFF (`src/domains/<name>/`). This complements `/scaffold` (new structure) and `/code-builder` (new feature into existing code): `/fix-defect` is **diagnosis-first** — it reproduces and root-causes **before** it edits, then fixes the minimal surface and proves the regression is closed.

This command is the **main thread**: only it launches subagents by delegating via your `agents` list. **Subagents never launch further subagents.** Every stage is planned, budgeted, and gated by the governance trio:

- **@supervisor** owns the run — plans the stages, allocates the tool-call/token budget from `budget-policy`, enforces the guardrails (`safety-rails`, `path-policy`, `dedup-policy`, `cache-policy`), and makes the go/no-go call between stages.
- **@critic** is the strict quality gate — returns `PASS` / `FAIL` per stage. A `FAIL` **blocks** the stage and **loops back to the fix** until the defect is genuinely closed.
- **@decision** resolves every ambiguity (vague bug, multiple plausible root causes, FE-vs-BFF ownership, reuse-vs-create on the fix) with a defensible, logged rationale.

**Defect to fix:** `$ARGUMENTS`

---

## Operating model (read first)

- **Console.** The run emits the standardised three-part console via the `console-render` skill (see `console/CONSOLE-UX.md`): an **Intro card** at the start, **one block per stage**, and a **Summary** at the end. Never print ad-hoc output — route it through `console-render`.
- **Budget.** `@supervisor` plans the stages and allocates the tool-call/token budget per `budget-policy` (default `tool_budget` 60). The `budget-check` skill is tallied after every stage boundary; if a stage would breach the ceiling, `@supervisor` makes the go/no-go call before continuing.
- **Model ladder.** Each agent runs at its default tier (`model-routing-policy`). Escalate exactly ONE rung only on low self-eval confidence (<0.7) or two `@critic` FAILs; escalation is logged and budgeted, never auto-downgraded.
- **Cache.** Read-only fetch/scan/diff work is served through `cache-lookup` (keyed `skill_id, version, input_hash`, per `cache-policy`). NEVER cache the fix edits, tests, the `@critic` verdict, self-eval, or LLM completions.
- **Dedup.** Build steps run `dna-precheck` first (precedence `REUSE > EXTEND > CREATE`, per `dedup-policy`); anything common moves to `eq-one-shared` via the `@shared-curator` + `move-to-shared` path rather than being re-fixed per MFE. No dead code is left behind.
- **Safety/paths.** Honour `safety-rails` (no secrets in code or logs, no PII — G4/G5) and `path-policy` (the fix lands in the correct MFE / `eq-one-shared` / `eq-one-design-system` / BFF `src/domains/<name>/`). BFF data-access fixes respect G8 (async DB), G9 (parameterised SQL), G10 (no stack traces in API responses); endpoints keep their auth attributes (G11).

---

## Staged flow

### Stage 0 — Plan & budget (Intro card)
`@supervisor` reads `$ARGUMENTS`, detects whether it is a PBI/bug id or a raw stack trace, plans the stages below, allocates the budget per `budget-policy`, and emits the **Intro card** via `console-render`. Seeds the `TodoWrite` ledger and opens the per-run **agent-memory** runtime (`metadata.json`, `scratchpad.md`, idempotent `ledger.jsonl`, `handoff/`) under `.eq-sparks/agent-memory/<run-id>/` per the `memory-schema` runtime layout, and warms the cache (`cache-lookup`, `cache-policy`) for stable defect metadata.
- **Agents:** `@supervisor`
- **Skills:** `console-render`, `cache-lookup`, `budget-check`

### Stage 1 — Fetch defect context
If `$ARGUMENTS` is a PBI/bug id, `@supervisor` drives the `ado-context` skill (MCP:ado) to fetch the work item: title, repro steps, expected-vs-actual, severity, affected build/environment, attachments, parent epic, and any stack trace or log excerpt in the description. Read through the cache (cross-run cache is opt-in for stable metadata per `cache-policy`). If `$ARGUMENTS` is a pasted **stack trace**, this stage is **AUTO-SKIPPED with reason** ("no PBI/bug id supplied") and the trace itself is taken as the defect signal. Emits the stage block (normalised defect summary).
- **Agents:** `@supervisor` (drives the fetch)
- **Skills:** `ado-context`, `cache-lookup`

### Stage 2 — Reproduce & locate (`@scanner` + `@codegen`, PARALLEL)
Pin the defect to concrete code **before** changing anything. `@scanner` (haiku, via `cache-lookup`) does the mechanical `Grep`/`Glob` localisation — maps the stack-trace frames / repro hints to exact files, routes, and BFF `src/domains/<name>/` folders — **in parallel with** `@codegen` (sonnet) attempting the minimal reproduction (failing test / repro harness / log-confirmed path) that captures the bug. Both run their loops and hand back findings. If ownership (which MFE, the shell, `eq-one-shared`, or a BFF domain) is unclear, `@decision` makes the logged call. Emits a stage block mapping the defect → location → confirmed repro.
- **Agents:** `@scanner`, `@codegen` (parallel), `@decision` (on ambiguity)
- **Skills:** `cache-lookup`

### Stage 3 — Root-cause (`@architect` + `@decision`, BARRIER)
This stage is a **barrier**: it waits for both Stage-2 agents to return before reasoning. `@architect` (opus, read-only, single-shot) takes the repro + localisation and determines the **true root cause** — not the symptom — and the minimal-surface fix plan (which file/route/domain, reuse-vs-create, whether the fix belongs in `eq-one-shared`). `@decision` (opus) records the chosen root cause and reuse/extend/create call with a defensible rationale when more than one cause is plausible. `@critic` reviews the root-cause hypothesis (`PASS`/`FAIL`); `@supervisor` makes the go/no-go before any write. Nothing is edited until this gate passes. The plan travels forward as a **handoff envelope** carrying the location, root cause, and `artifacts.{reuse,extend,create}`.
- **Agents:** `@architect`, `@decision`, `@critic`, `@supervisor`
- **Skills:** `console-render`

### Stage 4 — Fix (`@codegen` / `@db`, surgical)
The owning worker applies the **minimal** fix for the approved root cause:
- **FE defect** → `@codegen` (sonnet) for general edits; the relevant frontend specialist when one owns the change (`@contract` for FE↔BFF type drift, `@state` for store/Zustand fixes, `@design-system` to replace a hand-rolled component with `eq-one-design-system`, `@a11y` for an accessibility defect, `@mfe` for module-federation/boundary issues).
- **BFF defect** → `@codegen` for general edits; `@db` (sonnet) for any **data-access** root cause — enforcing G8 (no synchronous DB calls), G9 (no string-concat SQL — parameterised/ORM), connection/transaction/timeout patterns and N+1 removal; `@bff-shaper` for response-shape bugs; `@downstream-connector` for downstream resilience/timeout/retry defects; `@domain-folder` for domain-folder structure.
Every build agent reads the inbound **handoff envelope**, runs its **autoresearch loop** (`methodology/autoresearch-loop.md`) with **dna-precheck** at entry (or consumes Stage 2's cached scan) and **self-evaluate** as the mandatory last step, honours `path-policy`/`dedup-policy` (common code moves to `eq-one-shared` via `@shared-curator` + `move-to-shared`), then emits an envelope to the regression-test agents. Confidence <0.7 triggers a one-rung escalation. Emits a stage block of the diffs applied.
- **Agents:** `@codegen`, `@db`, and the owning specialist(s) above; `@shared-curator` when code moves to shared
- **Skills:** `dna-precheck` (entry), `self-evaluate` (exit), `cache-lookup`

### Stage 5 — Regression tests (`@tester` + supporting testers, PARALLEL)
Prove the defect is closed **and** nothing regressed. `@tester` (haiku) authors/runs the regression test that captures the original bug (the Stage-2 repro, now passing) and the surrounding unit cases — **in parallel** with `@contract-tester` (sonnet, pins the FE↔BFF boundary via `contract-diff` when a BFF shape changed) and `@integration-tester` (sonnet, covers cross-MFE impact when the fix touches a federated boundary). `@reviewer` (sonnet) does the cheap-to-find correctness/convention pass first so the opus `@critic` spends budget only on hard calls. Emits a stage block of test results + coverage per affected surface.
- **Agents:** `@tester`, `@contract-tester`, `@integration-tester` (parallel), `@reviewer`
- **Skills:** `contract-diff`, `cache-lookup`

### Stage 6 — Critic gate (PASS / FAIL, loop-back on FAIL)
`@critic` (opus, invoked sparingly) reviews the fix + regression evidence against EQ standards and the original defect: the root cause (not the symptom) is fixed, the regression test genuinely fails without the patch and passes with it, no new drift, no hand-rolled component where a shared/design-system one exists, no dead code, guardrails honoured. **FAIL blocks** and loops back to **Stage 4** for the owning worker to rework (escalating one tier on two consecutive FAILs), then re-test, until PASS or `@supervisor` calls stop on budget. On **PASS**, `@supervisor` makes the final go/no-go. Emits the gate block.
- **Agents:** `@critic`, `@supervisor`
- **Skills:** `budget-check`, `console-render`

### Stage 7 — Summary
`@supervisor` makes the final go/no-go, runs `budget-check`, aggregates **every** `handoff/*.json` envelope in `seq` order (per `handoff-protocol`), and emits the **Summary** via `console-render`: root cause, files changed by repo (MFE / shared / design-system / BFF domain), the regression test added, residual risk, critic verdict and any loop-backs, `@decision` rationales, tier escalations, open items, and the final `budget-check` tally vs the `budget-policy` ceiling. `@docs` updates any README/JSDoc/XML-doc/changelog to match the diff. The `agent-memory` ledger is closed for a clean `/resume`.
- **Agents:** `@supervisor`, `@docs`
- **Skills:** `console-render`, `budget-check`

## Handoff & memory

Stages **compose** by passing a structured **handoff envelope**, never free text. As each stage's agent finishes, it writes a single JSON envelope via the **`handoff`** skill to `.eq-sparks/agent-memory/<run-id>/handoff/<seq>-<from>-to-<to>.json` (schema + routing in `methodology/handoff-protocol.md`), declaring its `to_agent`, `decisions`, `artifacts.{reuse,extend,create}`, `self_eval`, `budget`, and `next`. The orchestrator (this main thread) is the **router**: it reads the closing envelope and launches the named recipient, pointing it at the latest envelope addressed to it — agents never spawn their own successors.

- **Memory open (Stage 0).** `@supervisor` opens/updates the agent-memory runtime per the `memory-schema` runtime layout (`shared/memory/memory-schema.md`): `metadata.json`, the per-run `scratchpad.md`, the idempotent `ledger.jsonl`, and the `handoff/` envelope dir — all under `.eq-sparks/agent-memory/<run-id>/` (gitignored), instantiated from `shared/memory/templates/`, and updates the ledger as the defect moves `pending` → `done`/`blocked`.
- **Routing.** Stage 2's location + repro routes to `@architect` (root-cause), the root-cause plan to the Stage-4 owning worker, the worker's diff to the Stage-5 regression testers, and those to `@critic`. On a `@critic` FAIL the envelope routes **back** to the producing worker (Stage 4) with the required changes in `open_items`.
- **Loop + self-eval.** Build agents run the **autoresearch (A-Rag) loop** (`methodology/autoresearch-loop.md`): they read the inbound envelope, investigate through the cache, act surgically, and `self-evaluate` LAST (the diff-based `self-evaluate` for `writesDiff` agents; read-only/gate agents — `@scanner`, `@architect`, `@reviewer`, `@critic` — self-ASSESS) before emitting the outbound envelope at loop step 9.
- **Aggregation (Stage 7).** `@supervisor` reads **every** `handoff/*.json` envelope in `seq` order and aggregates the chain, decisions, aggregate artifacts, open items, and final budget into the `console-render` Summary, then closes the ledger.

This is intra-run, agent→agent composition — distinct from `/resume` (the cloud→IDE Flow-3 handoff of the whole run), which replays the same ledger and envelopes this command wrote.

---

## Parallelisation

Only this command (the main thread) fans out; subagents never launch subagents. Independent work runs **concurrently**, and the run **barriers** at the `@critic` gate.

- **Stage 2 (Reproduce & locate) — PARALLEL.** `@scanner` (mechanical localisation) and `@codegen` (minimal repro) are independent and run **concurrently**. `@decision` is invoked only if ownership is ambiguous.
- **Stage 3 (Root-cause) — BARRIER.** `@architect` waits for **both** Stage-2 agents to return before reasoning, then `@critic` gates the root-cause hypothesis — the **first `@critic` barrier**: no edits happen until PASS.
- **Stage 4 (Fix) — usually serial, parallel only when disjoint.** A single defect normally has one owning worker. When the approved fix spans **independent, non-overlapping** surfaces (e.g. a FE `@codegen` edit and a disjoint BFF `@db` data-access fix touching no shared files), those workers run **concurrently**; any change to a shared file (`eq-one-shared`) is **serialised** to avoid write conflicts.
- **Stage 5 (Regression tests) — PARALLEL.** `@tester`, `@contract-tester`, and `@integration-tester` cover different surfaces and run **concurrently**; `@reviewer`'s cheap pass runs alongside them.
- **Stage 6 (Critic gate) — BARRIER.** The run **barriers at `@critic`**: it waits for all Stage-5 testers before gating PASS/FAIL. A **FAIL loops back to Stage 4** (escalate one tier after two FAILs) and re-tests before re-gating.

---

## Steps

1. **Parse `$ARGUMENTS`.** Detect a PBI/bug id vs a raw stack trace. Launch `@supervisor` (Stage 0) to emit the Intro card, plan the stages + budget (`budget-policy`), seed the `TodoWrite` ledger, open the agent-memory runtime (`memory-schema`), and warm the cache.
2. **Stage 1 — Fetch.** Launch `@supervisor` to run `ado-context` for the PBI/bug via `cache-lookup`. Auto-skip with reason if `$ARGUMENTS` is a raw stack trace.
3. **Stage 2 — Reproduce & locate (PARALLEL).** Launch `@scanner` and `@codegen` **concurrently** — `@scanner` localises via `Grep`/`Glob` (cached), `@codegen` builds the minimal repro. Launch `@decision` for any ownership ambiguity and log the rationale.
4. **Stage 3 — Root-cause (BARRIER).** After both Stage-2 agents return, launch `@architect` (root cause + minimal-surface plan) and `@decision` (record the chosen cause + reuse/extend/create). Gate with `@critic`; `@supervisor` go/no-go. Do not write until PASS.
5. **Stage 4 — Fix.** Launch the owning worker — `@codegen` / `@db` / `@bff-shaper` / `@downstream-connector` / `@domain-folder` / `@contract` / `@state` / `@design-system` / `@a11y` / `@mfe` / `@shared-curator` — reading the inbound `handoff` envelope, running its autoresearch loop with `dna-precheck` first and `self-evaluate` last, editing only allowed paths (`path-policy`/`dedup-policy`). Run disjoint workers concurrently; serialise shared-file edits. `budget-check` after the stage.
6. **Stage 5 — Regression tests (PARALLEL).** Launch `@tester` (regression + units), `@contract-tester` (`contract-diff` on a changed BFF shape), and `@integration-tester` (cross-MFE) **concurrently**, with `@reviewer`'s cheap pass alongside.
7. **Stage 6 — Critic gate (BARRIER).** Launch `@critic` for strict PASS/FAIL. On **FAIL**, loop back to step 5 → step 4 with the required changes (escalate one tier after two FAILs) until PASS or budget stop. `@supervisor` runs `budget-check` and gives go/no-go.
8. **Stage 7 — Summary.** Launch `@supervisor` (+ `@docs`) to aggregate all `handoff/*.json` envelopes in `seq` order, emit the `console-render` Summary, run the final `budget-check`, and close the `agent-memory` ledger.

> Note: only this command (the main thread) uses the **Agent** tool to launch subagents. Subagents never launch further subagents.

## Usage

```
/fix-defect Bug 49120
```
Fetch ADO bug 49120, reproduce + locate it (`@scanner` ∥ `@codegen`), root-cause it (`@architect` + `@decision`, `@critic`-gated), fix the minimal surface, add the regression test, and gate with `@critic` — governed end to end.

```
/fix-defect PBI 50337
```
Same flow driven from a PBI carrying repro steps; if the root cause is BFF data-access, `@db` applies the fix (async + parameterised, G8/G9) and `@contract-tester` pins the boundary if a shape changed.

```
/fix-defect TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'balance') at SipSummaryPanel.tsx:42
```
No id, so Stage 1 auto-skips; the pasted **stack trace** is the defect signal. `@scanner` maps the frame to the SIP MFE, `@codegen` reproduces, `@architect` root-causes, and the fix lands in the right MFE (or `eq-one-shared` if the cause is shared).

```
/fix-defect Bug 51002
```
Cross-cutting defect: if the fix spans a disjoint FE edit and a BFF `src/domains/<name>/` data-access fix, `@codegen` and `@db` run **concurrently**; the run barriers at the `@critic` gate before anything is called closed.

`$ARGUMENTS` is a PBI/bug id (e.g. `PBI 50337`, `Bug 49120`) or a pasted stack trace. The orchestrator reads ADO only when given an id, and otherwise only the repos referenced by the defect. If the defect is vague or multiple root causes are plausible, `@decision` resolves the fork with a logged, defensible rationale before any edit.

## Resume & checkpoint (interruption-safe)

This orchestrator is resumable after any interruption (IDE closed, crash, cancel). At **Stage 0** the orchestrator writes `.eq-sparks/agent-memory/<run-id>/metadata.json` with `orchestrator: "fix-defect"` and the ordered `stages` list, and seeds `ledger.jsonl` with each stage `pending`. After **every** stage passes its gate, the orchestrator — the main thread, which holds `Write`; `@supervisor` is read-only and only specifies *what* to record — **appends a `done` line** to `ledger.jsonl` with that stage's `task_id` + `content_hash` (per [dedup-policy](../shared/guardrails/dedup-policy.md) / [memory-schema](../shared/memory/memory-schema.md)). The ledger is written **incrementally after every stage, not only at the end**, so finished stages survive an interruption. PBI/Figma context is read from the no-TTL **story cache** `.eq-sparks/cache/story-cache/<pbi>.json` and is **never re-fetched**. If interrupted, **`/resume`** reads `metadata.json`, re-enters *this* orchestrator at the first `pending` stage, and skips work already marked `done`.
